warning: Platform numbers drift. If Instagram's app disagrees with this file, the app is right; update this file and open a PR.

feed_preview_chars.note: Approximate. The feed cuts the caption to about two lines and adds '... more'. Varies by device and line breaks.

name_field_chars.note: The name field is searchable; the bio is not weighted the same way.

bio_links.note: Most accounts can add up to five links in the profile editor; only the first shows inline.

feed_portrait.note: Safest default; can be boosted as an ad.

feed_tall.note: Matches the 3:4 profile grid. Reported as not boostable at time of check.

grid_preview.note: The profile grid crops every post to 3:4. Keep key content in the centre of 4:5 designs.

reel_safe_zone_1080x1920.note: Conservative margin. The caption, action rail and audio strip cover these areas.

ranking_signals.note: Instagram's head has publicly named watch time, likes per reach and sends per reach as the top signals (January 2025). Sends per reach matters most for reaching non-followers.
